_canon_basis: Author decision 2026-11-14: two-tier system. Mission personnel wear a flight-suit-cut coverall; the civilians Marco names in CH12 (Jonah, Evelyn, Thane) wear a field jacket of the same fabric over their own clothes. Project VALKYRIE is joint U.S. and corporate funded (faction dossier, 2049), so a U.S. flag and an unbranded sponsor tab appear, but no service-branch insignia. Each character's master.json sets their tier and role-tab color.
